## Result

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue and any affected product contract.

## Validation

List relevant tests/scenarios and PASS, FAIL or NOT RUN. Include the selected platform/toolchain.

## Limits

Describe material risks, compatibility changes and unverified scenarios.

- [ ] Documentation and English/Russian README are aligned where affected.
- [ ] Only relevant tests were run with disposable fixtures.
- [ ] No private profiles, adapters, credentials, internal work items or personal artifacts are included.
- [ ] Bundled HTML and third-party notices are current if panel/dependencies changed.
- [ ] No live Bootstrap, generators, cleanup, remote CI or iOS/tvOS builds were run without an agreed scope.
